title: ExplainReport
description:
The merged per-nodeid dossier. `null` fields are simply absent from every
cache (e.g. a never-flaked test has no `flakes` entry). `found` is false when
the nodeid appears in no cache at all.

coverage.description: Files this test covered, if a warm coverage index has it.

duration_seconds.description:
Last recorded call-phase duration in seconds (see `history` for the
spread).

flakes.description: Cross-run flake/fail counts + last-event epoch, if the test has any.

found.description: Whether the node id appears in any cache.

history.description: Recent runs, if the per-test history has any.

last_outcome.description:
`"passed"` if the test was green on the last incremental run; `null`
otherwise (absence is not proof of failure; see `flakes` for fail
history).

meta.description: Envelope: producer, document kind, schema version and rstest version.

nodeid.description: The node id that was explained, as given.

source_line.description: Source def line (1-based) recorded on the last incremental run, if known.

Coverage.description:
The coverage footprint of one test: the source files it covered and the
total number of covered lines across them.

file_count.description: Number of source files the test covered.

files.description: Covered source files, sorted, rootdir-relative (the coverage-index keys).

line_count.description: Covered lines, summed across those files.

failed.description: Runs where the test hard-failed (quarantined failures included).

flaky.description: Runs where the test passed only after rerun(s).

last_epoch.description: Unix epoch of the last recorded event (flake or failure).

last_failed_epoch.description:
Unix epoch of the last hard failure. 0 = none, or a cache written
before this field existed (readers then fall back to
`last_epoch` when `failed` is non-zero).

HistorySummary.description: The test's recent runs from the per-test history (oldest first).

auto_quarantine_at.description:
Flips at which `--auto-quarantine` catches a test (`[tool.rstest]
auto-quarantine` or the default; `0` = off).

auto_quarantined_next_run.description:
Whether the next run auto-quarantines this test (`flips` reached
`auto_quarantine_at`), unless the `--auto-quarantine-max` cap trips.

call_median.description: Median call-phase seconds over passing runs.

call_p95.description: 95th percentile (nearest rank) call-phase seconds over passing runs.

env_changed.description:
When the latest run failed: whether the environment fingerprint
(interpreter, lockfiles, installed packages) differs between the last
passing run and the first failing one.

first_fail_commit.description:
When the latest non-skipped run failed: commit of the first run in that
failing streak (skips inside the streak are ignored). Suffixed `-dirty`
like `last_pass_commit`.

flips.description:
Flips in the recorded runs: a pass only on rerun, or a failure right
after a pass (the `--auto-quarantine` rule).

last_pass_commit.description:
Commit of the most recent passing run; suffixed `-dirty` when that run
had uncommitted changes.

outcomes.description:
Outcome per run, oldest first: `passed`, `failed`, `errors`, `skipped`,
`xfailed`, `xpassed`, `quarantined`, `flaky` or `crashed`.

setup_median.description: Median setup-phase seconds over passing runs.

suspect_commits.description:
When the latest run failed: the commits after `last_pass_commit` up to
`first_fail_commit` (`git log last..first`), newest first. Empty when
both are the same commit; null when git can't resolve them here.

Meta.description: Envelope metadata for the explain document.

rstest_version.description: The rstest version that wrote the document.

SuspectCommit.description: A commit between the test's last pass and its first failure.

subject.description: First line of the commit message.
